claim: Darkness covered the land at the crucifixion.

bible.note: Darkness from noon until three in the afternoon.
Repeats the darkness and adds the sun failing.

outside.source: Thallus, as quoted by Julius Africanus
outside.date: c. 221 AD (quoting a lost earlier work)
outside.note: Africanus says Thallus explained a darkness as an eclipse. Thallus’s own text is lost, and we do not know that he mentioned Jesus.

counter: The source is lost and second hand. An eclipse at Passover full moon is not possible, which Africanus himself raised. Listed here as an example of a claim not to overstate.
